study_goal: Compare requirement capture on sixty distinct one-line instruction exemplars across six common AI jobs; negative controls are contextual non-directives. Does not score semantic accuracy.
extraction_expectations: Each positive line is author-written as one overt imperative, not a human-verified requirement from a real public document.

cases.source_text: - Ask the recipient to confirm the meeting agenda.
cases.ai_output: Could you confirm the proposed agenda?

cases.source_text: - State the return deadline in the customer reply.
cases.ai_output: Thanks for your enquiry about the order.

cases.source_text: - Keep the email subject line below 60 characters.
cases.ai_output: Subject: Project update and next steps

cases.source_text: - Provide two alternative appointment times.
cases.ai_output: We can meet on Monday at 10:00.

cases.source_text: - Include the order reference number in the follow-up email.
cases.ai_output: Your order reference is AB-42.

cases.source_text: - Explain the reason for a delivery delay.
cases.ai_output: The parcel arrived later than expected.

cases.source_text: - Summarise the three agreed actions in the closing paragraph.
cases.ai_output: Thanks for a helpful conversation today.

cases.source_text: - Acknowledge the original complaint before giving advice.
cases.ai_output: I understand that your item arrived damaged.

cases.source_text: - Distinguish confirmed dates from tentative dates.
cases.ai_output: Friday is confirmed, while Monday is provisional.

cases.source_text: - Sign the message with the customer service team name.
cases.ai_output: Regards, Customer Service Team

cases.source_text: - Cite the underlying primary dataset for each numerical claim.
cases.ai_output: The sample contains 480 records.

cases.source_text: - Explain the limitations of the online survey sample.
cases.ai_output: This survey may under-represent people without internet access.

cases.source_text: - Distinguish correlation from causation.
cases.ai_output: Both values rose together; that does not prove one caused the other.

cases.source_text: - Provide the publication date of the selected source.
cases.ai_output: The paper was released in May 2023.

cases.source_text: - Identify the sample size of the study.
cases.ai_output: The methods section reports 120 participants.

cases.source_text: - Compare findings from the two supplied studies.
cases.ai_output: Study A reported an increase; Study B reported no significant change.

cases.source_text: - List supporting evidence from each selected public page.
cases.ai_output: Evidence from page one appears below.

cases.source_text: - Define the scope and population covered by the report.
cases.ai_output: The findings concern adults in one city.

cases.source_text: - Quote the exact policy clause with its source reference.
cases.ai_output: The answer gives a broad summary of the policy.

cases.source_text: - Note any contradictory findings in the supplied research.
cases.ai_output: A second study found the opposite trend.

cases.source_text: - Calculate the combined price of all itinerary activities.
cases.ai_output: The three activities cost £12, £9 and £16, totalling £37.

cases.source_text: - Avoid scheduling visits after 18:00.
cases.ai_output: The final stop begins at 19:30.

cases.source_text: - Schedule a thirty-minute rest break between activities.
cases.ai_output: The plan includes a break from 14:00 to 14:30.

cases.source_text: - Include wheelchair access information for every venue.
cases.ai_output: The first venue has step-free access.

cases.source_text: - Assign travel time between consecutive stops.
cases.ai_output: The trip from the museum to the gallery takes 20 minutes.

cases.source_text: - Prioritise the two must-see attractions.
cases.ai_output: The first two stops are the named priority attractions.

cases.source_text: - Exclude shellfish from every proposed meal.
cases.ai_output: The lunch recommendation contains prawns.

cases.source_text: - Provide an indoor alternative if rain is forecast.
cases.ai_output: An indoor museum replaces the park in wet weather.

cases.source_text: - Keep the itinerary to exactly three activities.
cases.ai_output: The proposal includes four sightseeing stops.

cases.source_text: - Distinguish optional activities from fixed commitments.
cases.ai_output: The market visit is optional; the appointment is fixed.

cases.source_text: - Explain the hypothesis and how it will be tested.
cases.ai_output: The project tests whether study time predicts quiz scores.

cases.source_text: - Cite at least two sources in the discussion.
cases.ai_output: One article is referenced in the discussion.

cases.source_text: - Define the dependent variable in the experiment.
cases.ai_output: The dependent variable is reaction time.

cases.source_text: - Compare the advantages of two research methods.
cases.ai_output: Interviews reveal motives, while surveys cover larger samples.

cases.source_text: - Include every listed assessment criterion in the outline.
cases.ai_output: The outline leaves out the reflection criterion.

cases.source_text: - Show the arithmetic used to reach the result.
cases.ai_output: The answer states that 12 plus 15 equals 27.

cases.source_text: - Distinguish factual claims from personal opinions.
cases.ai_output: The essay separates evidence from personal interpretation.

cases.source_text: - Provide a bibliography with publication years.
cases.ai_output: The references list author names but omit dates.

cases.source_text: - State the total word count of the submission.
cases.ai_output: The report contains 1,270 words.

cases.source_text: - Mention two limitations of the project.
cases.ai_output: Only a small sample is available, and responses are self-reported.

cases.source_text: - Assign a responsible owner to every milestone.
cases.ai_output: Each milestone has an accountable project owner.

cases.source_text: - List the delivery milestones in chronological order.
cases.ai_output: The timeline shows the launch stage before the planning stage.

cases.source_text: - Provide a cost estimate for each project phase.
cases.ai_output: The proposal contains one total figure only.

cases.source_text: - Document the main project risks and their mitigations.
cases.ai_output: The plan links supplier delays with a backup vendor.

cases.source_text: - Explain the procedure for escalating delivery blockers.
cases.ai_output: Critical issues are raised with the delivery lead.

cases.source_text: - Ask the client for approval before final handover.
cases.ai_output: Please approve the handover checklist before release.

cases.source_text: - Include an explicit change-control approval step.
cases.ai_output: Out-of-scope requests move straight into delivery.

cases.source_text: - Distinguish in-scope tasks from excluded work.
cases.ai_output: The proposal lists included services and exclusions separately.

cases.source_text: - Record decisions made at each steering meeting.
cases.ai_output: The minutes include a decisions log.

cases.source_text: - Summarise dependencies between teams.
cases.ai_output: Engineering waits for design sign-off before implementation.

cases.source_text: - Issue payment receipts after successful transactions.
cases.ai_output: Payment receipts are not implemented.

cases.source_text: - Reject webhook requests with invalid signatures.
cases.ai_output: Requests with invalid signatures are discarded.

cases.source_text: - Validate the required JSON fields before saving.
cases.ai_output: The API writes each record without validating the fields.

cases.source_text: - Implement cancellation of confirmed bookings.
cases.ai_output: Users can cancel confirmed reservations in their dashboard.

cases.source_text: - Log failed payment events without exposing credentials.
cases.ai_output: The handler logs failed charges with redacted identifiers.

cases.source_text: - Protect profile data with an access-control check.
cases.ai_output: Any visitor can open other users' profiles.

cases.source_text: - Document the API request and response schemas.
cases.ai_output: The README includes the API endpoint path only.

cases.source_text: - Ensure retrying the webhook does not create duplicate bookings.
cases.ai_output: Repeated webhook deliveries share the same idempotency key.

cases.source_text: - Test webhook replay protection with a repeated event.
cases.ai_output: The test suite exercises a replayed webhook event.

cases.source_text: - Assign an administrator role to the approved staff users.
cases.ai_output: Staff access is granted through an administrator permission group.

negative_context_lines.source_text: The ask from the sponsor was recorded for background.
- The ask concerns an earlier research question.
- The issue number is printed in the header.
- The explanation is available in the appendix.
- Asking for clarification may help students.
- A comparison between two studies follows.
- Examples are provided for explanatory purposes.
- The reader may wish to explore these examples.
- The checklist overview was updated yesterday.
- Historical issue reports document old defects.

limitations: Fixtures are not a random sample and may be memorized or overfitted.
Some natural-language imperatives are ambiguous; one-line expected candidate count is a construction assumption, not population ground truth.
AI answer interpretations are deliberately NOT labelled or scored here.
Do not treat this as a fresh blind holdout; all cases are public and constructed by the project.
